title: A new option includes an earlier expectation

captions.physics: Combining changed conditions and earlier expectation
captions.emotions: Feeling closeness in freely given agreement

meaning: You can combine a new condition with acknowledging an earlier expectation and preserve closeness when the changed possibility is discussed as a free choice.
text: Temperance in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in combining new conditions with recognition of an earlier expectation. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports willingness to account for real changes and find a suitable continuation. The Lovers in emotions bring closeness through freely given agreement. You can change a proposal without pretending the earlier words never existed. A new possibility becomes shared when its present answer is heard rather than old consent transferred automatically.

For example, you promised a calm conversation after a walk, but an unexpected task shortens available time. A remark combines acknowledging that agreement with proposing a brief exchange now or another time. **Change preserves mutuality through a new answer**. You ask which option suits you both. Closeness can be felt through choosing without silently cancelling the earlier expectation. Wanting communication nevertheless requires neither accepting the first replacement nor pretending shortened time brought no disappointment.

One-sidedness appears if acknowledging expectation is merely a gentle introduction to a decision already made. Two sides then combine only in form while no free answer exists. The constructive Wheel helps account for an actual change in readiness too. You can name what is available and hear refusal of the proposal; another exchange need neither restore the earlier one exactly nor assign a changed answer for both.
